dz: 尼克平银行(Nyköping Banquet):瑞典国王比尔格(Birger)险恶地夺取了自己的两个兄弟德库斯·瓦尔德马尔(Dukes Valdemar)和埃里克(Erik),他们随后被饿死在尼克平城堡地牢.
de: The Nyköping Banquet: Birger, King of Sweden treacherously seizes his two brothers, dukes Valdemar and Erik, who are subsequently starved to death in the dungeon of Nyköping Castle.

te: The Nyköping Banquet (Swedish: Nyköpings gästabud) takes place as King Birger of Sweden celebrates Christmas at Nyköpin…
dz: 尼克平银行(瑞典语:Nyköpings gästabud)在瑞典国王比尔格在尼克平城堡庆祝圣诞节时举行. 嘉宾中包括他的两个兄弟瓦尔德马尔公爵和埃里克公爵,他们当晚晚些时候被囚禁并被最终饿死在城堡地牢.
de: The Nyköping Banquet (Swedish: Nyköpings gästabud) takes place as King Birger of Sweden celebrates Christmas at Nyköping Castle. Among the guests are his two brothers Duke Valdemar and Duke Eric, who later that night are imprisoned and eventually starved to death in the castle dungeon.
